alexcrichton opened PR #14672 from alexcrichton:fix-host-cancel-write to bytecodealliance:main:

The host was flagged as done too eagerly because the host trait implementation could decide to not accept it just yet. If the guest then cancels the write it should be able to write again but previously wasn't allowed to.
